items.markdown:
Vitamins and minerals only reverse or slow grey hair if your graying is caused by a documented nutritional deficiency or premature oxidative stress.[[1]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)[[2]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/nutrients/vitamins/fighting-gray-hair-with-vitamins/)

- **Vitamin B12:** Crucial for hair cell growth, pigment production, and supporting the body's natural antioxidant pathways. A B12 deficiency is frequently correlated with premature greying.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)[[2]](https://novoslabs.com/blog/skin-and-beauty/vitamins-for-gray-hair/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NHODP9JxhA0&t=13)
- **Folate (Vitamin B9):** Works alongside vitamin B12 to support cell division and DNA production in hair follicles.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/reverse-gray-hair)[[2]](https://www.amazon.com/Folic-Acid-Solution-restorer-capsules/dp/B01DUWXDQW)
- **Pantothenic Acid (Vitamin B5):** Helps maintain overall hair health and color.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Organic-Biotin-Vitamins-SOLUTION-Capsules/dp/B01ENNMPLG)
- **Vitamin D:** Low levels of Vitamin D and calcium have been linked to early pigment loss in clinical reviews.[[1]](https://novoslabs.com/blog/skin-and-beauty/vitamins-for-gray-hair/)[[2]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)
- **Copper:** Acts as an essential cofactor for tyrosinase, the enzyme required to produce melanin.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)[[2]](https://novoslabs.com/blog/skin-and-beauty/vitamins-for-gray-hair/)
- **Zinc and Iron:** Support the cellular health of hair follicles and melanin synthesis.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)[[2]](https://novoslabs.com/blog/skin-and-beauty/vitamins-for-gray-hair/)

### Do "Anti-Grey" Supplements Work?

- **General Aging:** If your grey hair is part of your natural genetic aging process, over-the-counter supplements and vitamins will **not** restore your original hair color.[[1]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)
- **Premature Deficiencies:** If your grey hair happens prematurely due to a lack of B12, folate, or copper, correcting the deficiency may help stop further pigment loss or partially restore color.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/reverse-gray-hair)
- **Enzyme Additions:** Many commercial blends include **catalase** (an enzyme meant to break down hydrogen peroxide accumulation in hair follicles) or amino acids like **L-tyrosine** , though large-scale clinical evidence proving they reverse gray hair remains limited. You can explore general insights via [Verywell Health](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859).[[1]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)[[2]](https://neofollics.com/products/anti-grey-hair-tablets)

If you'd like to narrow this down, let me know:

- Are you noticing grey hair at a **young age (premature)** or as part of normal aging?
- Have you recently had **blood work** done to check for vitamin or mineral levels?

I can help you figure out what to discuss with your doctor.
